thread:
maria: Compliance asks to shorten non-sensitive app logs to 90d. Before I flip SIEM export, any forensic or triage downsides?
alex: Which streams are non-sensitive?
maria: app-debug, feature-flags, client-side traces (non-auth). Keep auth/infra/sec-alerts at 365d.
devon: Ok but some traces leak headers/IDs. Need scrubbing classification or promote to escrow.
samir: If we expire, we need a JIT escrow for investigations. Who can unseal KMS?
maria: Draft plan: lifecycle -> 90d to cold S3 (kms:alias/redwood-escrow), expire at 365d, JIT assume-role via ticket+approvers for unseal.
alex: Add MFA condition and explicit KMS key policy limiting Decrypt to role. Log all decrypts.
ops-bot: next-run archive job scheduled 2026-04-02T03:00Z.
tay: Notify partners that consume exports; offer one-time historical export window.
samir: Triage note: keep an index (trace IDs, metadata) for 1yr so correlation still works without full payloads.
devon: Recommendation: incident-scoped snapshot extension to 1yr for high-sev only.
maria: Action list: update lifecycle config, create KMS key & policy, JIT role + runbook, partner comms, forensic dry-run, cost estimate. I'll draft RFC.
alex: Also add monitoring for archive-job failures and a restore SLA (sample restore <1h).
maria: Cool. I'll post RFC link when ready and @ops oncall for review. Thanks :pray:
